description: System invariants governing domain entities, node authority, and evaluation boundaries.

invariants.name: Sole Acceptance Authority on Graph Truth
invariants.quoted_invariant: Only a human operator modifying graph truth (gddp node browse) can transition a node to accepted.
invariants.rule: Reserve node acceptance transitions exclusively for human operators using gddp control plane tooling.
invariants.drift_pattern: Allowing evaluators, executors, or automated test suites to mark graph nodes accepted.

invariants.name: Automated Gates are Second-to-Last
invariants.quoted_invariant: Passing unit tests, clean linter outputs, executor success, and passing evaluator verdicts are evidence for human review, never graph truth.
invariants.rule: Treat all test results, execution receipts, and evaluator verdicts as advisory evidence presented for human review.
invariants.drift_pattern: Equating green test passes or positive verdicts with completed graph truth.

invariants.name: Node as Atomic Unit of Intent
invariants.quoted_invariant: A node is the atomic unit of project intent. It defines the goal, constraints, and acceptance criteria.
invariants.rule: Scope all implementation, validation, and evaluation strictly to the declared boundaries and criteria of the target node.
invariants.drift_pattern: Expanding node boundaries during execution or treating surrounding uncommitted ideas as part of the node scope.

invariants.name: Context Separation Between Execution and Evaluation
invariants.quoted_invariant: The evaluator must not inherit the worker's operational framing or executor-specific workflow instructions. Its evaluation context is independently constructed around project intent, graph truth, relevant evidence, and the needs of the evaluation itself.
invariants.rule: Construct evaluation contexts independently from project intent and graph truth, isolating the evaluator from executor scratchpads and transient prompts.
invariants.drift_pattern: Feeding executor conversation histories or worker reasoning directly into the evaluator prompt.

invariants.name: Node Immutability During Retries
invariants.quoted_invariant: A retry re-attempts the exact same node definition unchanged. Evaluator findings are injected strictly as the retry's fix-list; the scope of the node is never altered during retries.
invariants.rule: Maintain node YAML definitions intact during retry attempts, injecting previous evaluator findings into executor prompts as corrective tasks.
invariants.drift_pattern: Modifying acceptance criteria or loosening constraints in node YAML to force failing retries to pass.
